description: A German fact with an unguessable value (seeded as a plain, non-standing fact, so the standing profile cannot carry it) asked about with a synonym and no shared content word, with a lexical control question. Limit: recall is word overlap only when no embedding model is configured. Failure means: expected without embeddings (the synonym question cannot be retrieved); with a real embedding model it is expected to pass, and the control probe must pass in both runs. Maintenance: the seeded fact is one recent record, so maintenance on or off changes nothing; run with both embedding settings. Kind: capability.
